scope: Test-only complete public-reader request URL/query/header projection and same-process receiver reconciliation. No application behavior changes.
semantics: Every observed request is counted. Complete original URL is keyed, with exact query order, all keys/values and duplicates represented. Known route/header/key labels only; unknown names and all values are keyed tokens and byte lengths.
Unknown routes, headers, keys, malformed or oversized inputs, private known-value matches and overflow invalidate scoped acceptance. No sensitive values are emitted.
Actual browser headersArray and actual Node rawHeaders are canonicalized only for header order/case. Missing or changed receive shapes fail exact reconciliation.

Track every asynchronous browser inspection; early rejected tasks increment observerErrors before removal. Close browser and drain inspections before final snapshot. Close receiver after window before its final snapshot.
Receiver subscribes only to existing Node24 ingress diagnostics for the configured local public-reader port; no fetch replacement, listener, proxy, service, retry or network lifecycle is added.
Require positive feed, equal request totals and full matching rows; absent, failed, partial or mismatched coverage cannot pass.
boundaries: One explicitly isolated public-reader window; other callers on the same port must be excluded or their extra requests make reconciliation fail.
No response-body analysis, native child/Anvil receiver observation, extension-wide capture, derived-account/cross-name unlinkability or timing guarantee.
Known private values and random32-byte HMAC key remain operator-private and identical for sender/receiver; never put them in public evidence or app configuration.
Use existing browser no-send/route guards alongside the new projection. This does not replace financial safeguards or the broader wire-campaign acceptance.
actualAcceptance: Not run. Root owns installation in the existing public-server process at next normal boundary and the read-only private-view journey.
dependencyRelease: Temporary node_modules symlink to physical lead removed after tests; all test processes closed, installed tree untouched.
